verdict.rationale: Cactus documents several non-interactive ways to drive it: a CLI (`cactus run`, `cactus benchmark`, `cactus convert`), a Python package and bindings, and a REST API with key-based auth. The API covers generating training data, fine-tuning, uploads, billing checks and model download. The docs also say the platform can be run from the CLI, Python or a coding agent with an API key, which supports scripted, headless automation on macOS, Linux and Windows without a GPU. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions, non-interactive auth/exit-code behavior), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
